heard: Who says of Cyrus, he is my shepherd? He will accomplish all that I please. Who says of Jerusalem, it shall be rebuilt? And of the temple, its foundation shall be laid? This is what the Lord says to his anointed, to Cyrus, whose right hand I have grasped To subdue nations before him and strip kings of their armor to open doors before him I will go before you and level the mountains I will shatter doors of bronze and cut through
